title: Optical Instruments: The Eye, Camera, and Microscope

blocks.text: Have you ever wondered how cameras capture images or how our eyes see the world around us?

blocks.markdown: Optical instruments like the eye, camera, and microscope use lenses to manipulate light and form images. Understanding these systems helps us appreciate how we see and capture images.

blocks.title: Lens System
blocks.text: A lens system is a combination of lenses that work together to focus light and form an image.

blocks.markdown: The human eye functions much like a camera. It uses a lens to focus light onto the retina, similar to how a camera lens focuses light onto film or a sensor. The cornea and lens of the eye work together to focus light, while the iris controls the amount of light entering the eye.

blocks.title: Understanding the Eye as a Lens System
blocks.prompt: Describe how the eye functions as a lens system.

steps.text: Light enters the eye through the cornea, which begins the focusing process.
The lens further focuses the light onto the retina, forming an image.
The retina converts the image into electrical signals sent to the brain.

blocks.answer: The eye uses a lens system to focus light onto the retina, similar to how a camera focuses light onto film.

blocks.markdown: A simple microscope uses a single lens or a combination of lenses to magnify small objects. This allows us to see details that are not visible to the naked eye.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Remember, the eye and camera both use lenses to focus light, but the eye adjusts focus by changing the shape of its lens, while a camera adjusts by moving its lens.

blocks.markdown: One common defect of vision is myopia, or nearsightedness, where distant objects appear blurry. This is caused by the eye focusing light in front of the retina. A concave lens can correct this by diverging light rays before they enter the eye, allowing them to focus on the retina.

points: Optical instruments like the eye and camera use lens systems to focus light.
A simple microscope magnifies small objects using lenses.
Vision defects like myopia can be corrected with lenses.
